children: FIVE BELOW, INC reported strong results for the quarter ended 2026, with revenue of $1.26B, net income of $221.4M and diluted EPS of $3.99, driven by higher comparable-store sales, new store openings and improved gross margins versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.
Revenue growth was supported by comparable sales gains (14.1% for the quarter; 18.3% YTD) from higher traffic and modest price increases, and by store expansion.
E‑commerce and third‑party delivery contributed to omnichannel reach and were included in comparable-sales reporting.
Gross margin improved materially, aided by tariff refunds and lower shrinkage, which supported operating leverage and the profit recovery.
Store base expanded to 2,022 locations (from 1,858), with roughly 150 net new stores planned for FY2026 alongside investments in a shipcenter and infrastructure.
